title: SessionRecoveryChanged
description: Params for the session.recoveryChanged notification: the recording's own answer to session.recoveryStatus, pushed when that answer changes. It is metadata only — the recorded stream's end offset and the ranges the recording does not hold — and carries no recorded bytes. A reclaim reads session.recoveryStatus once, before it attaches, while the recording is still catching up on the replay; this notification is how the number a person is shown keeps being the ledger's number rather than the one the reclaim happened to catch.

sessionId.description: The server-minted session id whose recording changed.

produced.description: End offset recorded for this session, as session.recoveryStatus reports it at the same instant.

gaps.description: The ranges this session's recording does not hold, in stream order and disjoint, exactly as session.recoveryStatus answers them. Always an array; contains metadata only.
